cost.note: includes every block produced, failed and inconclusive alike

precondition_evaluation_point: K5 and K6 are evaluated only when both routes have their full frozen block count, as the checkpoint specifies. The K5 concentration statistic is sample-size dependent: a clean Gaussian sample has a median top-1 share of 0.23 at n=20 and 0.043 at n=200, so the frozen 0.10 limit discriminates only at n=200.
rounding_policy: test statistics rounded AWAY FROM ZERO at 12 decimal places before comparison against exact limits; conservative for every <= gate
